The intention with this game was to be like the truck sim games but with trains and the concept is there and there's some good to it. It's like Truck Sim with the added progression of city levels where similar to Transport Fever delivering enough of the correct stuff ranks up cities. Man, I really wanted to give this game a good review. And three+ years ago, I really enjoyed it! The game was a great mash-up of a Fallout-style world with a heavy focus on base-building and Sims-like team management. It did a lot of things well and had a ton of potential, but just needed some love and polish and a bunch of bug fixes. And then... And then it all stopped. The devs suddenly went quiet and that was it: abandonware. I would guess that mediocre initial reviews and lack of a clear path to profitability probably made someone decide to cut their losses and pull the plug, but we'll never know. Kudos to whoever put out the Unity patch but make no mistake: this game is dead and you sho
